highlights: Third quarter net sales of $2.063 billion increased 3.1% on a reported basis and 3.7% on a constant currency 1 basis
Third quarter diluted earnings per share were $1.00, a decrease of 13.8%; adjusted 1 diluted earnings per share were $1.90, consistent with the prior year period
The Company reported third quarter net sales of $2.063 billion, an increase of 3.1% over the prior year period and an increase of 3.7% on a constant currency 1 basis.
Diluted earnings per share were $1.00 for the third quarter, a decrease of 13.8%, and adjusted 1 diluted earnings per share were $1.90, consistent with the prior year period.
Zimmer Biomet generated $560.0 million in operating cash flow and $372.4 million of free cash flow 1 in the third quarter.

quotes.text: We are very pleased with our solid third quarter results, growing net sales 3.7% on a constant-currency basis and generating strong operating and free cash flow.
quotes.by: Ivan Tornos, Chairman, President and CEO of Zimmer Biomet
